votes.motion: Approve the Bootlegger grease trap expansion design pending Weston & Sampson's formal approval, with the requirement that a Commission representative be present to inspect the work.
votes.quote: butch made the motion, carl seconded, vote taken was unanimous.

votes.motion: Accept Version 1 of the FY13 budget, with the $1000 amount removed from Vehicles, taking $73,208.40 from Retained Earnings.
votes.quote: butch made the motion, jay seconded, vote taken was unanimous. budget to be put forward to the fincom will be to take $73,208.40

votes.motion: Approve the credit of $121.50 for 74 Prospect, with the understanding it could be rescinded if no irrigation meter is installed.
votes.quote: bob asked for a motion to approve the credit of $121.50. butch made the motion, jay seconded, vote was unanimous.

votes.motion: Adjourn the Regular Meeting, without intent to re-open, and enter Executive Session to discuss contract negotiations and litigation.
